assertions: Desktop initial no horizontal overflow
HTTP 200, nonblank homepage; real 720px WebM actively advances
Like, save and follow actual browser state transitions
Comment submitted visibly, stored locally; Escape closes modal
Likes, saves, follow and comments persist after reload
Sharing copies an actual story deep link
Keyboard next, Space pause/play, ambient sound toggle and actual seeking
All six independently decoded local WebM clips are 720×1080, >4.5 seconds
Following and saved feeds filter by actual local state
Topic filters, text search, empty state and reset work
Desktop after interactions no horizontal overflow
Creator profile has actual media grid and reopens selected video
Valid story parameter opens requested story; invalid falls back to first
Device-video selection creates playable local-only preview; no upload or remote sharing
Desktop wheel scrolling snaps to another actual story
Mobile initial no horizontal overflow
Mobile tap playback, like, comment, follow, following filter and genuine touch scroll
Mobile after interactions/search no horizontal overflow
Mobile expanding search returns the matching video
Reduced-motion/storage-disabled mobile remains usable
Reduced motion starts paused; blocked localStorage gracefully falls back to memory
No HTTP, failed resource, console or page errors in desktop/mobile/fallback tests

触屏测试初次滑动短于半屏触发原生吸附回弹；改用超过半屏的连续实际触控事件并验证换条。
补充 tag 字段至本地文本检索，修复 green 标签搜索后实测通过。

summary: 已完成 Hearthline 独立静态首页：六段原创本地真实 WebM 视频、单条滚动播放、播放暂停/拖动、点赞收藏评论关注、筛选搜索、创作者网格、键盘与移动触屏操作。桌面/移动实测通过；已打开审阅两张真实 QA 截图及新预览。登记默认关闭，未构建或发布。
limitations: 采用获准的 HTML/CSS/ES-module 静态适配，不是 Vite/React/TypeScript/Tailwind 产物；系统字体替代指定字体。
按本轮明确要求使用六段原创动画视频，覆盖原始公开 prompt 的照片模拟、禁用视频文件要求；没有复制第三方视频或付费 demo。
仅公开原始需求可用，Pro 私有布局与资产未提供；不声称精确复刻私有 demo。
社交计数/种子评论和创作者为示例。点赞收藏关注与新增评论仅浏览器本地，无生产认证、实时社交或后端。
设备视频仅会话内本地预览，不上传、不发布；音轨为用户开启后生成的双音振荡器。
